title: Route only to the account-selected model provider
summary: Dispatch Credits to AccountsExecutionAdapter and Google or OpenAI subscription to BrokerExecutionAdapter. An unavailable exact selection fails; it never silently selects a different provider or model.

replaceability.why: The model route and its cash authority are the Lumeri spending foundation.
replaceability.decided: Self-Luc spec v0.3 (2026-10-18); charter rule 6; today's code: lumeri_runtime/model_execution.py:499-556

operations.name: available_for_account
operations.notes: No deadline enforced. Credits checks late resolver availability without resolving a signing client; Broker checks the selected local authority. Exceptions yield false; no provider execution or route change.

operations.name: prepare

request.description: Runtime gate request with exact selection, budget reservation and scope. See iface:process.execution/v1.

call.description: AccountsProviderCall for Credits, BrokerProviderCall for the exact selected Broker provider.

output.description: Python DurableSideEffectRunner bound to the exact route and execution; see iface:process.execution/v1.

operations.notes: No aggregate deadline enforced by router. A live gate and optional output_presentation are additional Python dependencies. Wrong call type raises TypeError; absent adapter raises ValueError, not a coded error. Preparation creates a durable runner; executing it may spend budget. Idempotency is enforced by the execution gate and selected adapter, not by the router.

invariants.text: An absent selected Broker adapter refuses instead of calling Accounts; health checks do not resolve Accounts credentials.

break: the operation raises unexpectedly or returns an answer outside its declared schema
failure.notes: Reject an unavailable or mismatched selection. Iron-rule layer fallback cannot mean choosing another provider; no new provider authority is inferred.

conformance.notes: Existing tests are evidence for the named invariants, not a replacement conformance runner. Only the area contract checker is run in this task.

open_questions.text: Router Python signatures take a live gate and runner objects. A future wire interface must reference the process area execution identity without serializing those objects.
